words.meaning: to yearn for; look forward to
words.note: 对未来的憧憬 = one's hopes for the future. Warmer and dreamier than plain 期待.
崎岖的山路 = a rough mountain trail. Also figurative: 道路崎岖 = a hard road ahead.
蓬勃发展 = to boom/thrive; 生机蓬勃 = brimming with life.
饱经沧桑 = to have been through a lot. From 沧海桑田 (seas turning to fields).
缔造传奇 = to create a legend. Grand, formal — for empires, records, eras.
灵感迸发 = a burst of inspiration; 迸发出活力 = to brim over with energy.
从中斡旋 = to mediate between parties. Diplomatic register.
思维缜密 = a rigorous, watertight mind. 缜密的计划 = an airtight plan.
初见端倪 = the first hints are showing; 看出端倪 = to spot a lead.
交通枢纽 = a transport hub. The point everything else connects through.
有涵养 = composed and gracious under pressure. Also: to conserve (水源涵养).
昭示着未来 = points the way to what's coming. Formal, often written.
保持缄默 = to keep silent. More literary than 沉默.
睿智的判断 = a shrewd, far-seeing call. A compliment for deep wisdom.
匠心独运 = uniquely inventive; 独具匠心 = one of a kind by design.
遭受挫折 = to hit a setback; 经得起挫折 = able to take knocks.
恬静的乡村 = a peaceful countryside. A calm, unhurried stillness.
了却夙愿 = to fulfill a lifelong dream. 夙 = long-standing.
A crosstalk-flavored exclamation, now everywhere online. 好家伙,这也行? = 'whoa, that actually worked?' Surprise, awe, or mock-outrage.
满满的松弛感 = totally at ease, nothing forced. The aspirational 2020s aesthetic of looking relaxed and unhurried.
提供情绪价值 = to make someone feel good. The buzzword for what people now say they want from partners, friends, even brands.
特种兵式旅游 = cramming a dozen sights into a weekend on no sleep and no money, military-style. From 'special forces'.
爱是双向奔赴 = love is both people running toward each other. Beloved on relationship posts; also for friendships and teamwork.
突然词穷 = mind suddenly blank. Also the 2023 buzz-complaint that short-video brain has left people unable to find words.
别阴阳我 = quit being snide with me. 阴阳 alone is now a verb for saying one thing and meaning the sarcastic opposite.
这操作太逆天了 = that move was absolutely insane. Can praise or condemn — context decides. Literally 'defying heaven'.
羡慕 clipped down to one syllable + 了. 慕了慕了 = 'ugh, I'm so jealous', usually happy-jealous.
他秒回我 = he texted back in a heartbeat. The flattering opposite of being left on read.

words.meaning: fun to watch while eating; entertainingly bad
words.note: Literally 'goes with rice'. 下饭视频 = something you put on over a meal. Of a player: 下饭操作 = play so bad it's entertaining.
人生顶配 = living your best, maxed-out life. From 顶配 phone/car trims.
被已读不回 = got seen and ignored. The dreaded receipt-then-silence.
家人们, 主播真的哭了 = 'folks, your streamer is literally crying'. The core word of livestream culture.
How streamers address viewers: 家人们谁懂啊 = 'folks, does anyone feel me?'. Warm, in-group, faintly ironic off-stream.
About the harshest common curse. 操 is the vulgar verb; also written 草/艹 to dodge filters. Deeply offensive — never casual.
老子不干了 = 'I, your father, quit'. Puffed-up, aggressive 'I' — rude to the listener. (Different word, 老子 lǎo dān, means the philosopher Laozi.)
A crude insult for a woman. Also softened/reclaimed jokingly as 小婊砸 among friends, but the base word is offensive.
狗 (dog) + 东西 (thing) = a contemptible person. 你这个狗东西 = 'you rotten dog'. Can be mock-affectionate between close friends.
你去死吧 = 'just die'. Also a flustered, half-joking 去死啦 when teasing. Tone decides how serious it lands.
A homophone laundering of 傻屌, now so mild it's affectionate: 沙雕网友 = 'goofball netizens'. The tame end of the swear scale.
去你妹的 = 'to hell with that'. A milder stand-in for cruder 你妈 curses; irritated but rarely truly vicious.
Crude for the male organ, but 屌爆了 / 很屌 = 'freaking awesome'. The polite homophone 吊 is used to soften it in writing.
Northeastern flavor of 滚. 一边滚犊子去 = 'buzz off'. Coarse but often more blustery than hateful.
你有毛病吧 = 'is something wrong with you?'. 毛病 = a defect/fault; as an insult it questions someone's sanity. Rude but everyday.

words.meaning: the finishing touch that brings it to life
words.note: 'Dotting the dragon's eyes.' The small final stroke that makes the whole thing come alive.
'Smash the pots, sink the boats.' Commit totally with no way back — from a general who stranded his own army to force victory.
'The old man lost his horse.' Full form 塞翁失马,焉知非福 — misfortune may turn out lucky, so don't judge too soon.

words.meaning: twice the result for half the effort
words.note: The efficiency dream: less work, more payoff. Its opposite is 事倍功半.
'Fierce as thunder, fast as wind.' Acting resolutely and without dithering.
把一切安排得井井有条 = to arrange everything in perfect order. Not a hair out of place.
被团灭 = the whole team got wiped; 打出团灭 = ace the enemy. The swing moment of a teamfight.

words.meaning: to feed; hand over free kills
words.note: 别送人头了 = stop feeding. Dying pointlessly and gifting the enemy gold/XP. Short form: 送.

words.meaning: to ride a strong teammate's coattails
words.note: 抱大腿 = cling to the 'big leg' (the carry) and let them win it for you. Also used in life for latching onto a powerful ally.
手感火热 = on fire, hitting everything; 手感冰凉 = ice-cold, can't land a thing. Also the physical feel of a keyboard/controller.
走位风骚 = slick, unpredictable movement (dodging skillshots). 走位飘逸 = elusive positioning.

words.meaning: low HP; one hit from dying
words.note: 残血逃跑 = limping away on a sliver of health; 残血反杀 = clutch a kill while nearly dead.
